listing.name: Yuki's Tactical Display
listing.summary: Adds a configurable tactical display widget to the combat UI showing fleet assignments, status, flux bars, and armor integrity.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a configurable tactical display widget to the combat UI showing fleet assignments, status, flux bars, and armor integrity.

description:
Originally called Nightcross Tactical Display

Adds a tactical display widget to the combat UI anchored to the left side of the screen, with configurable position. Shows your fleet along with their assignments and status, as well as flux bars and CR/PPT in visual form. The sprite turns red as the ship takes hull damage while the armor plates represent the armor integrity on different sides of the ship.

You can also use it to issue orders to toggle retreat, seek escorts, or search & destroy without entering the command UI. It still takes command points to do so.

Has an option to show enemy fleet as well, could theoretically be used for tournaments

Requires magiclib and lunalib. Still in pre-release.

How to use

Using LunaLib config, adjust the height and spacing to your desired position. It will show up in the simulator so you can test it without reloading a save. Ideally it should leave some space for the scrolling text log on the top left of the screen as they will intersect and look bad.

Also note, there is an option to flip the position, which is how I actually use it most of the time- it goes really well with

Combat Radar

when the vertical and horizontal positions are flipped. Just position it with some offset so it doesn't clip with the radar.

You can use it to issue commands by clicking the text for "retreat" "escort" or "S&D" and then clicking a ship icon. You can also disable this feature if you do not wish to risk misclicking.

For larger battles you will definitely need to lower the ship icon size. I'm looking for feedback on how it looks at different resolutions, would be nice to leave a screenshot of how it looks on your screen! I may also need to add an ultra-compact mode or size slider at some point.
